correctness.rationale: The seven-state transitions are the standard unique coloring of the Wielandt digraph. An independent complete subset-BFS gives minimum reset length 31 and unique minimum-distance singleton state 2. Exact polynomial propagation along all shortest subset edges gives z^6(1+z)^20 and total 1048576; the inspected verifier independently reproduces the same polynomial by a reverse-distance optimal-DAG recursion. The published witness has length 31. The computation exhausts the complete finite power automaton.

It does not enumerate all shortest reset words or their letter-count distribution. value.rationale: W7 is a canonical slowly synchronizing benchmark, and shortest-word multiplicity is a natural invariant of its optimal reset language rather than an arbitrary statistic. The compact binomial profile is an exact self-contained finite fact useful for checking enumeration/sampling methods. Under the stated standard, the existence of an unfinished larger-family pattern does not by itself make the exact W7 result worthless.
